description: This file defines the AuditManagerClient class for AWS SDK in PHP. It provides method signatures for interacting with the AWS Audit Manager service, including features like creating, deleting, and fetching assessments, controls, reports, and managing permissions. The class extends AwsClient and includes annotated methods for synchronous and asynchronous API calls.

classes.name: AuditManagerClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Audit Manager service, providing methods for various resource management and data retrieval actions.

methods.name: associateAssessmentReportEvidenceFolder
methods.description: Associates an assessment report evidence folder with a specified assessment.

methods.name: batchAssociateAssessmentReportEvidence
methods.description: Batch associates assessment report evidence across multiple assessments.
